# `/`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
expr1 / expr2
```

Returns `expr1`/`expr2`. It always performs floating point division.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT 3 / 2;
```

Result:

```text
1.5
```

```sql
SELECT 2L / 2L;
```

Result:

```text
1.0
```
